lines: Revenue was £116.7 million, up 10.5% reported and 12.3% at constant currency year over year.
Gross margin increased 400 basis points to 62.2%; adjusted EBITDA loss improved to £22.1 million from £48.3 million in H1 2025.
Clinical revenue grew 35.4%, BioPharma 25.0%, Industrial 6.2% and Research 5.4%; PromethION product-range revenue increased 15.7%.
Loss for the period narrowed to £48.0 million, while cash, cash equivalents and other liquid investments were £234.5 million at June 30, 2026.

FY26 constant-currency revenue growth guidance remained 16%-20% excluding a $20 million non-recurring licensing fee; adjusted EBITDA breakeven in FY27 and positive free cash flow in FY28 were reaffirmed.
